offer_title: Creative Cloud Pro for ₹1,199 a month in your first year
offer_description: New subscribers pay ₹1,199 a month for 12 months on the annual plan billed monthly. It then renews at the regular ₹2,714 a month.
eligibility: New subscribers in India buying directly from Adobe. 12-month commitment. One per customer.

offer_title: Creative Cloud Pro for ₹12,999 for your first year, paid upfront
offer_description: New subscribers pay ₹12,999 for the first year on the prepaid annual plan. It then renews at the regular ₹30,656.40 a year.
eligibility: New subscribers in India buying directly from Adobe. One per customer.

offer_title: Photography plan 1 TB for ₹599 a month in your first year
offer_description: Photoshop and Lightroom with 1 TB storage at ₹599 a month for the first year, then ₹638.38 a month.
eligibility: New subscribers in India. 12-month commitment, billed monthly.

offer_title: Creative Cloud Pro for students and teachers: ₹398.99 a month
offer_description: Eligible students and teachers pay ₹398.99 a month for the first year on the annual plan billed monthly, or ₹3,999 prepaid.
eligibility: Students and teachers at eligible institutions. Adobe checks proof of eligibility. First year only.

offer_title: Prime annual for ₹999 before Prime Day 2026
offer_description: A limited-period anniversary offer cut annual Prime from ₹1,499 to ₹999 ahead of Prime Day, 4–6 July 2026.

offer_title: Google AI Plus at ₹199 a month for 6 months
offer_description: New subscribers have been offered AI Plus at ₹199 a month for the first six months, then ₹399 a month.
eligibility: New Google AI Plus subscribers in India, first 6 months.

offer_title: Apple Music at ₹115 a month for iCloud+ subscribers
offer_description: Since September 2026, paying iCloud+ subscribers in India can add full Apple Music at a discounted price.

offer_title: Google AI Pro free for 18 months with Jio Unlimited 5G
offer_description: Google and Jio announced free Google AI Pro for 18 months for eligible Jio Unlimited 5G users, activated in the MyJio app.
eligibility: Jio users on eligible Unlimited 5G plans. Check the MyJio app to see if your plan qualifies.
